&.notes: New ampersand with independent loop and crossing strokes fitted to this family’s weight and width; no historical ampersand is claimed.

J.notes: New J with the observed I’s wedge entry and high-contrast stem, plus a rounded bottom related to U.

Z.notes: New Z with the sharp triangular E terminals and heavy diagonal of the observed N/X.

7.notes: New lining 7 uses a flat wedge-ended top and a curved diagonal related to the source figure 1 and the lower bowl rhythm of 6.

9.notes: Inferred 9 rotates the clear 48-point 6; terminal direction is reconstructed.

0.notes: Reconstructed 0 replaces the small 12-point trace with a narrowed large O. The small source establishes a plain oval zero.

Q.notes: Reconstructed Q uses the large observed O and a drawn curved tail, replacing the tiny 8-point impression.

p.notes: Reconstructed p uses the large observed d bowl and stem, rotated to form a descender, following the tiny 8-point p crop.

q.notes: New q reflects the reconstructed p; its bowl and stem derive from the observed d.

f.notes: New f with the wedge-shaped lowercase entry and a ball terminal related to a/c/r; no lowercase f is printed.

j.notes: New j retains the observed circular i dot and wedge entry, with an inferred leftward descending hook.

z.notes: New lowercase z follows the reconstructed Z at the source lowercase body height.

3.notes: Reconstructed 3 replaces the coarse 8-point impression with narrow rounded bowls and wedge-ended terminals derived from the larger observed figures.

$.notes: New dollar sign based on this face’s observed S with an added vertical stroke.
